description: A two state machine that steps on each trigger and puts out one of two voltages for whichever state it lands in

params.text: Sets the chance of staying in state A on the next trigger, 0 to 1
Sets the chance that state A puts out its first value rather than its second, 0 to 1
Sets the first of the two voltages state A can put out, -10V to 10V
Sets the second of the two voltages state A can put out, -10V to 10V
Sets the chance of staying in state B on the next trigger, 0 to 1
Sets the chance that state B puts out its first value rather than its second, 0 to 1
Sets the first of the two voltages state B can put out, -10V to 10V
Sets the second of the two voltages state B can put out, -10V to 10V
Attenuates the voltage at the jack on that row before it is added to the large knob beside it

inputs.text: A rising edge here steps the machine, choosing a state and then a value to put out
Adds to the knob on that row through the small knob between them

outputs.text: Holds the value chosen at the last trigger
Carries 1V while the machine is in state A and 2V while it is in state B
Goes to 5V on the triggers that land in state A
Goes to 5V on the triggers that land in state B

notes: nothing moves until a trigger reaches the trig jack; the outputs read 0V before the first one
the two state outputs are held for about ten samples after each trigger and then drop back to 0V, which makes them a short pulse rather than a gate
